title: The Year Web 2.0 Began
narrative: The rubble of the crash clears and the participatory web takes shape. Facebook starts in a dorm, Gmail resets what free email means, Firefox breaks Internet Explorer's grip, and World of Warcraft shows how deep online communities can go. Someone finally gives the whole shift a name: Web 2.0.
